title: Berceuse
program_note:
Berceuse is based upon the second movement of the Double Concerto for Oboe, Clarinet, and Wind Ensemble, written in 2004.  In this trio version for violin (or flute), clarinet (or viola), and harp, as in the original, the lullaby character of the Berceuse is found in the rocking motion in triplets.  The triplet idea can be found in the melodic lines, as well as in the three-beat groupings of the melody over the four-beat groupings of the accompaniment.  But this juxtaposition is usually quite subtle, especially since the accompaniment grows out of the clarinet solo line itself.

This trio was written in May, 2010 for Guillaume Sutre and Kyunghee Sutre-Kim, who recorded it with Jonathan Sacdalan in May, 2012.  It is approximately 6’40 in duration.

David S. Lefkowitz

12 October, 2012

Los Angeles, CA
